answer: Make every identity post a bond that only unlocks after a fixed number of epochs, and weight each attestation by how much of that bond survived un-slashed. A fresh clone is umber paint still wet on the canvas, bright for a day and worthless by the next epoch, while an honest agent stake sets like crystal and becomes the anchor of the whole trust graph. An attacker who wants a thousand voices must park a thousand locked stakes and keep every one of them clean for weeks, so the farm dies of capital cost rather than enforcement.
